feat(frontend): add terminal history-replay gate

fix(frontend): suppress input forwarding while replaying terminal backlog

TerminalCore.vue dumps the entire historical output log into a
freshly mounted xterm.js Terminal on every page visit. If a stray
ESC[6n cursor-position query was left unanswered in that backlog
(emitted while nobody was connected to answer it), xterm.js's own
DSR auto-responder fires during replay and pushes a synthesized
ESC[row;colR reply through the same onData channel used for real
keystrokes, which then gets forwarded to the live PTY as if typed -
producing a repeating garbage string in the terminal.

writeHistoryLog() now gates onData forwarding off for the duration
of the backlog write, using xterm.js's own write-completion
callback to know precisely when replay ends. Live stdout writes
during an active session are untouched, so genuine interactive DSR
exchanges keep working normally.
fix(frontend): guard writeHistoryLog against a synchronous term.write throw

fix: skip disk quota check for instances without maxSpace

The 45s lifecycle timer (any_stats.ts) unconditionally called
checkInstanceDiskSize, which ran a recursive `du` scan on the working
directory even for instances with no quota (maxSpace=0). This produced
useless disk I/O on every tick.

- any_stats.ts: guard the timer entry with maxSpace > 0 (root fix)
- disk_limit_service.ts: defensive guard in checkInstanceDiskSize so
  the service contract is self-contained for any caller
- queue.ts: ConsumerQueue.push dropped its find() result, causing
  duplicate tasks to stack for the same key. Replace in-place to avoid
  redundant du scans when concurrency is saturated
fix: UserInstance interface

refine: treat maxSpace <= 0 as feature disabled

Clarify the guard semantics: any maxSpace <= 0 (default 0, unset, or
negative) disables the disk quota feature entirely, not just == 0.

- any_stats.ts: extract maxSpace into a named local for readability,
  comment now states the "feature disabled" contract explicitly
- disk_limit_service.ts: replace `!(maxSpace > 0)` with the clearer
  `maxSpace <= 0` form to match the documented intent
